MAMA-MIA.role: development with expert-reviewed primary tumor masks

Duke 3D.role: manual anatomy and vessel annotations, mapped to original patient identifiers
Duke 3D.access: TCIA research-use license on the supplemental segmentation distribution

I-SPY1.role: pilot DICOM reference and patient-linked derived functional masks
I-SPY1.identity_note: Map each appearance of the same patient to one partition across I-SPY1, MAMA-MIA and derived annotation releases.

MAMA-MIAAI.role: manual whole-breast envelope references, overlapping MAMA-MIA patient identifiers
MAMA-MIAAI.access: PhysioNet published terms; check recorded license before redistribution

ODELIA.role: official development and reserved case-level partitions; select both-breast lesion-free studies for negative exams
ODELIA.access: Hugging Face gate and provider's research/educational terms

EA1141.role: clinical and imaging-confirmed bilateral negatives with independent patient splits

AMBL.role: reserved external benchmark; match physical DICOM and complete reference coverage before scoring
AMBL.physical_reference: Source DICOM pairs verified by voxel equality and exact reorientation

BreastDM.role: reserved external benchmark; physical measures require verified spacing

Normal FGT.role: possible weak anatomical or breast-side covariates, requiring endpoint and geometry checks
Normal FGT.annotation_note: Verify the annotated side and annotation level. A side-level record cannot supervise a voxelwise FGT mask.
